summary: Retest of i18n legal-page update: German privacy policy and terms were replaced with FULL English translations (no longer a 'coming soon' placeholder), while German content stays untouched. 6 acceptance criteria covered by 6 browser checks + re-run of existing backend suite + typecheck. All checks passed (one check, lang-manual-switch-persists-reload, was flaky on first run due to the known hydration-timing race but passed cleanly on immediate rerun). The previously reported hydration-mismatch bug (iteration_25) did not reproduce as a thrown pageerror on the legal pages in this run; html lang still briefly shows 'en' at domcontentloaded before settling to 'de' after hydration, which is the same underlying timing behavior but it no longer surfaces as a console pageerror on these pages - treated as resolved for the explicit 'no hydration pageerror' criterion, flagged as a note for monitoring.

checks.criterion: English privacy policy uses the provided text
checks.name: privacy-policy-english-full-content
checks.evidence: With leonida-lang=en, /datenschutz shows data-testid=privacy-policy-english, heading 'Privacy Policy', 'Effective Date: November 12, 2026', sections 1 (Introduction) through 17 (Contact) present; no German privacy body text ('Verantwortlicher und Kontakt', 'Diese Datenschutzerklärung beschreibt') and no leftover 'coming soon' placeholder found in body text. Screenshot captured.

checks.name: terms-english-translated-content
checks.evidence: With leonida-lang=en, /nutzungsbedingungen shows data-testid=terms-english, heading 'Terms of Use', '1. Fan Project', '3. Community Rules – Zero Tolerance', 'Reporting, Blocking, and Moderation', 'Your Content' sections; no German terms body text and no placeholder text. Screenshot captured.

checks.name: legal-pages-german-unchanged
checks.evidence: With leonida-lang=de: /datenschutz shows privacy-intro 'Diese Datenschutzerklärung beschreibt...' and heading '1. Verantwortlicher und Kontakt'; privacy-policy-english and legal-english-placeholder have 0 count. /nutzungsbedingungen shows the existing German first paragraph and '3. Community-Regeln' rules text; terms-english and legal-english-placeholder have 0 count. Screenshots captured.

checks.criterion: Language switching still works after legal-page changes
checks.name: lang-manual-switch-persists-reload
checks.evidence: First run failed transiently (html lang read as 'en' right after reload, before hydration settled); re-run passed immediately: /profil language-option-de/en controls switch UI to German, persists stored leonida-lang=de across reload even when navigator.language is forced to en-US. Treated as flaky per rerun rule, not a bug.

checks.criterion: No hydration/runtime errors when starting in German
checks.name: legal-pages-no-hydration-errors-german-start
checks.evidence: Fresh context, localStorage leonida-lang=de, addInitScript applied before navigation: /datenschutz and /nutzungsbedingungen both render (privacy-page/terms-page visible), no pageerror thrown, console_errors=[], no >=400 responses, html lang settles to 'de' within 5s. Full result.json: console_errors:[] . NOTE: document.documentElement.lang briefly reads 'en' at the domcontentloaded instant before client hydration applies the stored/detected language (same mechanism noted in iteration_25) but this no longer produces a thrown React hydration pageerror or console error on these two routes in this run.

checks.criterion: TypeScript and protected push endpoints remain healthy
checks.name: typecheck-and-push-endpoints
checks.evidence: cd /app/frontend && yarn typecheck -> 'tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json' Done, exit 0. curl http://localhost:8001/api/health -> 200 {'status':'ok'}. curl http://localhost:8001/api/push/public-key -> 200 {'publicKey':'BEN6V2jC7x5MN7xZ...'}. curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8001/api/push/admin/status (no auth) -> 401. Backend pytest suite (test_tscheck_push_admin_protected.py + test_tscheck_health.py): 8 passed in 1.10s.

checks.criterion: Push admin endpoints are protected (re-run of prior backend artifact)
checks.name: test_tscheck_push_admin_protected.py
checks.evidence: Re-ran cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -q tests/test_tscheck_push_admin_protected.py tests/test_tscheck_health.py -> 8 passed in 1.10s, no code changes needed.

action_items: Monitor the pre-existing hydration timing race (html lang briefly 'en' before client correction) noted in iteration_25 - it did not surface as a thrown error on the legal pages this run, but was previously observed to intermittently throw a React hydration-mismatch pageerror on other routes (profile, karte, german-mode-unchanged). Not re-filed as a new bug this iteration since no pageerror was captured against the current acceptance criterion's explicit checks, but worth a dedicated regression check if it resurfaces.
